purpose: Source discovery for the first 20 quality-filtered UN WUP 2025 historical-growth urban centres; no new runtime integration implied.

ranking.metric: Average annual exponential population growth, percent per year
ranking.qualityFilter: Keep the bulk CSV Pop_plausibility values Moderate or High for Year=2025; exclude Low.
ranking.order: Descending unrounded annualGrowthPct2015To2025; cityCode ascending breaks ties.

methodology.registryFound: True means place-specific registry or cadastral-map evidence. It does not require anonymous vector access. Null means only broader leads or unresolved target identity/coverage.
methodology.verifiedTargetParcelSample: A real nonempty polygon response at the saved WUP target; nearby non-intersecting samples are excluded.
methodology.failedAttempts: Retained in each city evidence file, including sandbox failures distinguished from upstream failures.
methodology.conditions: Source conditions are informational; technical access and adapter readiness are recorded separately.
methodology.evidencePaths: Evidence and response-file paths resolve from world-parcels/.

cities.nextStep: Retry Ministry of Lands and GIS unit endpoints from another network; ask GIS/RS mapping authority or Land Commission for cadastral data/service details. No public parcel endpoint verified.

cities.name: Mutuati
cities.finding: Ardhisasa and Meru County leads; exact WUP locality and target cadastral coverage unresolved.
cities.nextStep: Exact WUP point is south of the common Mutuati centroid; confirm intended settlement/area. Ask Meru Land Registry/Survey Office for Mutuati cadastral coverage or parcel-map extracts; public vector endpoint remains unverified.

cities.name: Nandail
cities.finding: Official Nandail land office identified. DLRS survey selector returned no upazila entries; no target sheet or geometry verified.
cities.nextStep: The active Mymensingh survey chain returned no upazila entries. Check other survey editions / selector codes for Mymensingh district and recheck whether Nandail appears; request a single sheet only after the exact target mouza is exposed.

cities.name: Semapur
cities.finding: DILRMP inventories cadastral maps for Barari tehsil, Katihar, containing Semapur. Exact revenue mauza and target parcel geometry remain unverified.
cities.nextStep: Use the public Bihar hierarchy with Katihar district and Barari tehsil as the supported administrative lead, then reconcile Semapur locality to its exact revenue mauza and verify a sheet/parcel response. Do not infer target geometry from tehsil-wide map counts or the unsuccessful exact-name scan.

cities.name: Narayanpur
cities.finding: Nearby Char Kalipur/Gazaria DLRS sheet returned polygons, but none intersected the target test area; Narayanpur identity remains unresolved.
cities.nextStep: Resolve the exact Narayanpur place-name to a mouza around the WUP point; enumerate adjacent Gazaria BDS sheets and sample only the correct target-intersecting sheet, then confirm stable Dag_No identity in that sheet.

cities.name: Venjaramoodu
cities.format: JSON with attributes and MULTIPOLYGON Z WKT
cities.finding: Ente Bhoomi returned one parcel at the WUP point in published Manikkal village and the same geometry by parcel_gid. Viewport streaming remains unverified.
cities.nextStep: For another bounded sample, resolve a published village locationCode, acquire a fresh viewer session/CSRF pair, use click_info with a point in EPSG:32643, then feature_info filtered by the returned parcel_gid. The service terms should be reviewed before broader operational reuse; successful FGB/viewport streaming remains unverified.

cities.name: Shankarpur
cities.finding: Bihar BhuNaksha is a source lead; the supplied Shankarpur point has not been matched to its district, tehsil and revenue village.
cities.nextStep: Resolve the supplied point against authoritative administrative boundaries first. Only after district/tehsil/village identity is supported should its BhuNaksha registry and any target parcel sheet be tested.

cities.nextStep: The active Gaibandha survey chain returned no upazila entries. Check other survey editions / selector codes for Gaibandha and recheck whether Saghata appears; request a single sheet only after the exact target mouza is exposed.
